Definition: from G4396 ("prophecy"); prediction (scriptural or other):--prophecy, prophesying.
BiblicalUsage: Propheteia is prophecy, the gift of speaking God's word, and Paul puts it among the gifts to be desired. He says prophecy is for edification and exhortation and comfort, tells Timothy to war by the prophecies that went before on him, and John says the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prophecy is not fortune-telling but God speaking through his people to build the church up. And I hold that every true prophecy ends where John says it ends: in the testimony of Jesus.
